title: Cross-workspace access for serverless (Beta)
body: You can now control serverless network traffic between Databricks workspaces. Account admins use cross-workspace access to set which source workspaces can reach a workspace (ingress) and which destination workspaces a workspace's serverless workloads can send traffic to (egress). Traffic flows only when both the source workspace's egress rules and the destination workspace's ingress rules permit it. See [Cross-workspace access](/aws/en/security/network/front-end/cross-workspace-access).
